name: smwpatches-remove-cape-drop-delay
title: Remove Cape Drop Delay
description:
A simple Patch that removes the infamous drop delay frames when trying to drop down after floating with the cape (which can be any value between 0-16 in vanilla), which makes it consistent and responsive to the player.

You can just hex-edit the timer to be always 0, but this would also affect Yoshi Wings, which use the same timer.
